# Wesleyan University

> A selective liberal arts university in Middletown, Connecticut, known for its open curriculum, undergraduate research, and commitment to civic engagement and the arts.

Wesleyan offers distinctive programs through the Allbritton Center for the Study of Public Life, Jewett Center for Community Partnerships, Patricelli Center for Entrepreneurship, and Gordon Career Center. The university emphasizes hands-on learning, sustainability initiatives, and NESCAC athletics within a vibrant campus community.

## Key Topics

- Open curriculum
- Liberal arts education
- Undergraduate research
- Civic engagement
- Community partnerships
- Allbritton Center for the Study of Public Life
- Jewett Center for Community Partnerships
- Patricelli Center for Entrepreneurship
- Gordon Career Center

- Financial aid and no-loans policy
- NESCAC athletics
- Sustainability initiatives
- Middletown, Connecticut
- International student programs

## About Wesleyan

- [Why Wesleyan | Inclusive, Transformative Liberal Arts Education](https://www.wesleyan.edu/why-wesleyan/index.html): Open curriculum and hands-on learning in liberal arts environment
- [Wesleyan University at a Glance](https://www.wesleyan.edu/about/at-a-glance.html): Quick facts on Wesleyan's academics, demographics, and Middletown campus
- [Life at Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/life/index.html): Campus life overview: housing, athletics, clubs, and NESCAC sports
- [Explore Our Campus | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/life/explore-campus.html): Campus tour: Foss Hill, College Row, Center for the Arts

## Admission and Financial Aid

- [Application Process | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/admission/application-process.html): Apply via CommonApp, Coalition, or SCOIR with deadlines and requirements
- [Affordability and Aid | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/admission/affordability-and-aid/index.html): Need-based aid with no-loans policy and work-study options
- [Cost of Attendance | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/admission/affordability-and-aid/cost-of-attendance.html): Tuition, fees, housing costs breakdown via WesPortal
- [International Applicants | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/admission/undergraduate-admission/international/index.html): International admission guidance via OISA and WISP programs
- [Freeman Scholars | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/admission/undergraduate-admission/international/freeman-scholars.html): Full scholarship for East/Southeast Asian students via Freeman Program

## Academics and Curriculum

- [Arts and Humanities | Academics](https://www.wesleyan.edu/academics/undergraduate-academics/open-curriculum/arts-and-humanities.html): Arts & Humanities division: Art, Classical Studies, Dance departments
- [Capstone and Honors | Academics](https://www.wesleyan.edu/academics/undergraduate-academics/capstone-experience-and-honors-thesis.html): Senior capstone projects and departmental honors thesis requirements
- [Three Year Option | Academics](https://www.wesleyan.edu/academics/undergraduate-academics/three-year-option.html): Accelerated bachelor's degree path with AP/IB credit flexibility
- [Summer and Winter Sessions | Academics](https://www.wesleyan.edu/academics/undergraduate-academics/summer-and-winter-sessions.html): Intensive courses during summer and winter for credit acceleration
- [Continuing Studies | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/academics/continuing-studies.html): Adult learner programs: Community Scholars, Bachelor of Liberal Studies
- [Life After Wesleyan](https://www.wesleyan.edu/academics/life-after-wesleyan.html): Career outcomes and Gordon Career Center support for alumni success

## Research, Arts, and Community Engagement

- [Research With Impact | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/why-wesleyan/research.html): Undergraduate research via Allbritton Center and Wesleyan Media Project
- [Expression Through the Arts | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/why-wesleyan/the-arts.html): Arts programs: Film, Music, Dance, and Art History departments
- [Engagement is Woven In | Wesleyan University](https://www.wesleyan.edu/why-wesleyan/community-engagement.html): Community engagement programs via Jewett, Allbritton, and Patricelli Centers
